{{Quote|There's no more squad. We're all that's left!|Murtag|<ref name="Suicide Squads" />}}
'''Murtag''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Private/Legends|private]] who fought in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[301st Infantry]] during the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in a [[Fideltin Rusk's squad|squad]] under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]], Murtag joined his unit in recovering Imperial survey [[Map/Legends|maps]] of the nearby [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] region in order to aid several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] in their [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|covert mission]] on Hoth, but the squad was pursued by the Imperials and pinned down in a firefight in an [[Crescent Canyon Ortolan outpost|abandoned outpost]]. Severely wounded by the exploding [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] that the Imperials were using to attack his squad, Murtag was the only survivor of the fight other than Rusk, and the pair escaped from the Imperials with help from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Our objective was to secure Imperial survey maps of the starship graveyard. Target achieved. Imperial counter-attackers pursued us here. Squad fatalities: sixty-six point four percent. Enemy fatalities: one hundred percent.''"<br />"''Hang on&hellip; I'm picking up a fresh wave of probe droids outside. They're headed this way!|Rusk and Murtag|<ref name="Suicide Squads" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Jedipedia" /> Murtag enlisted in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> Murtag was a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[301st Infantry]], and he was assigned to a [[Fideltin Rusk's squad|six-man squad]] under the leadership of the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] with the Empire, the 301st Infantry was assigned to aid two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]&mdash;the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Leeha Narezz]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]]&mdash;in their [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|covert mission]] to retrieve the schematics for the [[Emperor's Fortress|personal space station]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. Sergeant Rusk and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were tasked with retrieving Imperial survey [[Map/Legends|maps]] of the nearby [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]], and the unit was successful in their mission.<ref name="Suicide Squads" />

[[File:301st.png|thumb|left|270px|Murtag, Rusk, and the dead members of their unit]]
However, Imperial forces pursued Murtag and the rest of the squad, and the unit took up a defensive position in an [[Crescent Canyon Ortolan outpost|abandoned outpost]] in the nearby [[Crescent Canyon]]. Rusk, Murtag, and their squad put a strong fight against their attackers, despite the Imperials sending [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] on suicide runs against them&mdash;the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] would rush the [[Republic trooper]]s and explode when they got close enough&mdash;and the unit defeated almost all of the Imperial pursuers. However, during the fighting, four of the squad's members were [[Death/Legends|killed]], and Murtag suffered third-degree burns and severe shrapnel wounds, leaving Rusk the only member of the unit still capable of fighting. Fortunately for the wounded [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], the Hero of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], whom Leeha Narezz had sent to the outpost with a companion to reinforce Rusk's quad, eliminated the remaining Imperials.<ref name="Suicide Squads" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Murtag was wounded and in shock when the Knight arrived, but his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] ordered the private to get back on his [[Limb/Legends|feet]] and prepare for the second wave of Imperial attackers. However, the Hero overruled Rusk and told Murtag to get behind cover, taking on the Imperials with the Knight's companion and Rusk. After the fighting ended, the Chagrian [[Officer/Legends|officer]] took Murtag to the nearest [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]], where the injured Human received treatment for his wounds.<ref name="Suicide Squads" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Murtag was fair-skinned with [[Color/Legends|dark-red]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He suffered severe burns and shrapnel wounds during the fighting on Hoth, and he received scarring across both sides of his face and on the bridge of his [[Nose/Legends|nose]]. While wounded, Murtag easily succumbed to panic and was terrified of dying.<ref name="Suicide Squads" />

==Equipment and training==
[[File:Rusk_and_Murtag.png|thumb|right|170px|Private Murtag and his commanding officer]]
{{Quote|He can hold a rifle. That's all the mission requires.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="Suicide Squads" />}}
As a member of the 301st Infantry, Murtag wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] decorated in the division's colors of white and dark blue. He wore a white chestpiece and equipment over a black [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] as well as dark blue shoulder [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]] in addition to his blue-and-white [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. In combat, Murtag carried a standard-issue [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], and he was trained in its use as a soldier of the Republic.<ref name="Suicide Squads" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|That all of them, Private?''"<br />"''Yes, sir. Did they cut the lights, or&hellip;''"<br />"''Squad fatalities: eighty-three point three percent.|Rusk and Murtag, as the soldier dies|<ref name="Suicide Squads" />}}
Murtag first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], during the Jedi Knight-class mission "Suicide Squads" on Hoth. Players can choose the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] option of ordering Murtag to stay put, which results in his survival, or they can choose the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] option of forcing him to fight and causing his death.<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> This article assumes that the player chooses only the moral light-side options as a Republic Jedi Knight character,<ref name="Light Side">This article assumes that the Republic classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] alignment points.</ref> and therefore it assumes that Murtag survives.<ref name="Suicide Squads" />
